blurb: Embark on a thrilling adventure in Denver! Uncover the city's secrets as you explore Civic Park and Downtown. Decode anagrams, solve riddles, and answer trivia about your surroundings. Marvel at the 1920s sculptures, learn about Denver's history, and even take a selfie with a giant bear sculpture! Discover the world's largest outdoor Christmas lighting display, and explore the city's vibrant arts, sports, and culture scene. Don't forget to dance with the Dancers!
